title: Sky Dimension Pack
description: Add a dimension based on Minecraft's early planned dimension
body:
# Appereance
The Sky dimension consists of floating islands above the clouds. It's always at noon and has no precipitation. Only chickens spawn naturally here. Plain villages and features like monster rooms, plants and ores also generate here, similiar to the plain biome in the Overworld. Besides there're currently two custom structures here: undead castle and witch house.
# Travel
To enter the Sky dimension, you should defeat the Ender Dragon first. Then craft a dream pillow (the recipe will be unlocked upon killing an ender dragon) and sleep with it in the Overworld.
To leave the Sky dimension, two methods are available. The first is the same as entering the Sky dimension. However, in the Sky dimension you can sleep regardless of time and weather. The second is by just falling into the void. Players will be teleported to the Overworld when below Y=96. (The max Y-value of taking damage from the void is 64, so don't worry about that.) 
# Mobs
Currently, three custom mobs only.
## Corpse
A glowing zombie spawned in the undead castle. It has much higher attack damage, armor and health than a normal zombie.
## Sorceress
A glowing witch spawned in the witch house. It throws and drinks potions with higher level than a normal witch does. Also it has 1/2 chance to throw a lingering potion.
## Sky remains
Currently the final boss in the Sky dimension. It does not spawn naturally. Instead, it is constructed by players like the Wither. Before summoning it, killing a Corpse and a Sorceress is needed. Place an iron block at (0,513,0), a bone block at (0,514,0) and a standing white banner with a black skull pattern at (0,515,0). Throw a blaze powder on the bone block. Then a platform of stones spawns at Y=512 and the Sky Remains appears on it. The Sky remains is a large glowing skeleton, but much stronger than a normal skeleton. It has two phases: in the first phase it uses melee attack while in the second phase it shoots tipped arrows and wither skulls as well as unlocks other skills like arrow trap and regeneration. Prepare yourself before challenging it!
## 
The spawn eggs of custom mobs are provided. Run command /function minecraft:spawn_egg to get them. (Note that Sky Remains summoned by spawn eggs do not behave the same as a normal summoned Sky Remains does.)

# 
This is my first data pack and is still in an early test. It may get updated in the future if I have enough time. Thanks for playing!
